mapper.sql: a.id, a.attempt_id AS attemptId, a.annotation_key AS annotationKey, a.sentence_id AS sentenceId, a.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, a.kind, a.status, a.proposed_answer AS proposedAnswer, a.reason, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.decision, '$.verdict')) AS decisionVerdict, a.decision_reason AS decisionReason, a.decided_by AS decidedBy, a.decided_at AS decidedAt, a.model_snapshot AS modelSnapshot, a.prompt_version_id AS promptVersionId, a.created_at AS createdAt, sv.zh AS sentenceZh, u.username AS username
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM appeals a LEFT JOIN sentences s ON s.id = a.sentence_id LEFT JOIN sentence_versions sv ON sv.id = s.current_version_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
